Output matches the original: `dist` hashes agree for n = 1, 2, 7, 100, 512, and 513, and `path` matches the reference at 1, 4, 64, and 256 threads.\n\n**Changes (only the two existing files):**\n- `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp`: `floydWarshall` now has one `#pragma omp parallel` region over all `k` passes, with a `#pragma omp for schedule(static)` over source rows `i` inside each pass. The implicit barrier between passes keeps the sequential `k` dependency intact.\n- Why rows are independent: row `k` never changes during pass `k`, because `dist[k][k]` is always 0. So each row `i != k` only reads row `k` and writes itself, and the row-`k` iteration is skipped as a provable no-op.\n- The inner loop is branch-free (`std::min` plus a conditional `path` update) so it vectorizes. The `path` matrix is still maintained, as before.\n- `floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`: `find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)` and `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX` added to the link. Executable name, flags, and the `m` link are unchanged. No new files, and I built in `/tmp` so the repo has no artifacts.\n\n**Timing** (AMD EPYC, n=512 / n=1024; original 165 ms / 1226 ms):\n\n| Threads | n=512 | n=1024 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | 59 ms | 366 ms |\n| 8 | 11 ms | 57 ms |\n| 16 | 8 ms | 36 ms |\n| 32 | 8 ms | 26 ms |\n| 64 | 11 ms | 24 ms |\n\n**Issue to be aware of:** this machine has 2 sockets, 128 physical cores, and SMT. At 256 threads, performance collapses (n=1024: 520 ms; n=512: 273 ms), because the per-pass barrier spans sockets and SMT siblings. The default thread count is 256 here, so a plain run is slow. Set `OMP_NUM_THREADS` to about 32–64 for best results. I didn't hard-code a cap because that's a policy choice.
